newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Mayr-Melnhof, United Pulp in jv.
newsitem.headline: Mayr-Melnhof, United Pulp in jv.

text.p: Austrian carton board producer Mayr-Melnhof AG said on Thursday it had reached a preliminary agreement with Singapore's United Pulp and Paper Co Ltd to set up a joint venture company in Singapore.

In a statement Mayr-Melnhof said the two firms had signed a memorandum of understanding to form a 50:50 joint venture. The new company would explore setting up plants in the Asia-Pacific region, Mayr-Melnhof said.

"The proposed joint venture is in line with the defined strategy of Mayr-Melnhof for Asia and it will enable the company to expand into the Asia and Pacific region with an established board and packager producer from Asia," chairman Michael Groeller said.
Mayr-Melnhof noted that UPP is a leading paper and board manufacturer in Singapore where it has the only integrated paper and board manufacturing and corrugated box plant.
Mayr-Melnhof has a 30 percent share of the European carton board market. -- Vienna newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
